name: Aroha McIntyre
bio:
Aroha grew up around motorsport, her father a keen amateur racer. She initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, driven by a fascination with how things worked. After graduating, she spent several years in the automotive industry before finally making the leap to racing, joining a small Formula Ford team. This hands-on experience cemented her understanding of vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. 

Aroha's approach is deeply pragmatic. She believes in data-driven decisions, meticulous preparation, and clear communication. Her time with Tony Kart Racing has been defined by a steady, incremental improvement in performance, earning her the respect of the drivers and mechanics alike. She's known for her ability to quickly diagnose problems and implement effective solutions under pressure. 

What sets Aroha apart is her calm demeanor and unflappable problem-solving skills. She thrives in the high-pressure environment of the track, never losing sight of the big picture while attending to the smallest details.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often held back with a simple headband.
physical.description: Aroha has a sturdy build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking green tea from a specific chipped mug during races.
